designSystem.name: no-vain-years Design System
designSystem.note: Account-level DS, VIRTUALLY inherited by every nvy/<context> project (reference, not copied files — a fresh project's list_files is empty). But the claude.ai preview sandbox resolves _ds/… by RELATIVE PATH, so assets must be materialised into each consuming project via mcp__claude-design__copy_files with src_project_id = THIS projectId (server-side, no context cost, no 256 KiB cap). Copy BOTH colors_and_type.css AND _ds_bundle.js (~71 KB — without it window.NoVainYearsDesignSystem_019dec components are unavailable). Never copy a sibling feature's frozen _ds/ snapshot. DS itself mirrors FROM apps/mobile/src/theme/ via /design-sync only (one-way; code is SoT).
